newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai bourse may lift finance, banks suspension.
newsitem.headline: Thai bourse may lift finance, banks suspension.

text.p: The Thai stock exchange said that a suspension in the trading of banks and finance counters ordered on Monday would likely be lifted on Tuesday.
"The exchange is likely to lift suspension if there is no negative situation like this morning," Singh Tangtasawas, the president of the Stock Exchange of Thailand, told reporters.

The suspension was ordered minutes after deals had been executed on the bourse and ahead of a statement that was to be released by the central bank and finance ministry on measures to help out the troubled finance sector.
Singh said the suspension, however, would continue for listed finance firms which were ordered by the Bank of Thailand to increase their capital immediately.
Among the 10 finance firms that received the order, three were listed firms: International Trust and Finance Plc, Dynamic Eastern Finance Thailand Plc and Sri Dhana Finance and Securities Plc.
